summary.headline: The historical V553/V551J temporal line is rich but provisional. Its identity, observation, key, delta, direction-class, gap/absence, noncomparability-register, rupture-candidate and per-anchor-permission functions are exact and conservable. Its scalar pressure field, interpolation methods, confidence fallbacks, numeric thresholds and declared-but-unread authority artifacts are not. Six concrete historical defects are reported so they are not conserved by accident.
